summary: Hyperscale Data, Inc. filed an 8-K reporting that on September 29, 2026, it and seven wholly owned guarantor subsidiaries entered into the Eighth Amendment and Guarantor Joinder to the December 14, 2023 Loan and Guaranty Agreement with JGB Capital, JGB Partners, JGB (Cayman) Buckeye, Deepdale Investors and JGB Collateral as agent. Affiliate Ault Company borrowed an additional $21 million, issuing secured notes totaling $22,580,645, with all loan maturities extended to December 14, 2027. The notes share existing collateral, security agreements, pledges and mortgages. This is a routine credit-facility amendment, not a special situation; watch refinancing risk and collateral coverage.
